raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Make the AMD MiniMax-M3 model defer each layer's FFN all-reduce into the next layer's norm, the same way the NVIDIA model already does. On its own this does not change performance. It is a prerequisite for ROCm all-reduce kernel work that is still in progress (see Details).



## Claims

- Both all-reduces in each AMD MiniMax-M3 layer can now go through the fused all-reduce + norm path. Before, only the attention-site one could.
- No performance change on its own. Output tok/s is within about 0.2 % of baseline in 6 of 7 configs. The 7th (8k/1k, c8) is +1.4 %, which I read as run-to-run noise.
- No quality regression. NIAH/GSM8K scores are identical to baseline.


## Validation

**Unit test (CPU only).** `pytest tests/models/minimax_m3/test_xlayer_allreduce_fusion.py` gives `8 passed`. The test drives the real `MiniMaxM3Model` wiring methods with stand-in layers. It covers the dense-then-MoE chain, which captures reduce, and every defer pattern and EAGLE3 capture set for 1 to 6 layers. In every case each deferred all-reduce is completed exactly once, and no capture sees a partial sum.

**Performance A/B.** gfx950, TP4, `amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, `vllm bench serve` with random data. A is this PR, B is baseline. Both sides use the same nightly (`2b009fc6d`) and the same flags.

| ISL | OSL | conc | A out tok/s | B out tok/s | A/B | A TPOT (ms) | B TPOT (ms) |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 8192 | 1024 | 8 | 937.82 | 924.85 | 101.4% | 8.18 | 8.29 |
| 8192 | 1024 | 32 | 2133.54 | 2134.05 | 100.0% | 14.04 | 13.99 |
| 8192 | 1024 | 64 | 2914.04 | 2912.97 | 100.0% | 20.71 | 20.73 |
| 8192 | 1024 | 128 | 3898.18 | 3893.81 | 100.1% | 30.19 | 30.26 |
| 60000 | 600 | 16 | 492.74 | 491.66 | 100.2% | 29.15 | 29.68 |
| 60000 | 600 | 64 | 586.88 | 585.87 | 100.2% | 99.44 | 99.62 |
| 128000 | 1024 | 16 | 385.98 | 385.13 | 100.2% | 37.41 | 37.74 |


**Quality.** RULER `niah_single_2` through lm-eval (`local-chat-completions`, seed 1234, 32 concurrent requests, max lengths 65536 and 131072). GPQA Diamond is TBD and will be added later.

| Check | This PR | Baseline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NIAH 65536 | 0.642 | 0.642 |
| NIAH 131072 | 0.774 | 0.774 |
| GSM8K 5-shot (flexible-extract) | 0.9272 | 0.9272 |
| GSM8K 5-shot (strict-match) | 0.9257 | 0.9272 |

## Details

**What changes.** The NVIDIA model (`vllm/models/minimax_m3/nvidia/model.py`) leaves each layer's FFN output un-reduced. The next layer's `input_layernorm`, or the final norm, then finishes the all-reduce through `fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm`. The AMD model never got this wiring. At TP > 1, every AMD layer pays for a separate full-size all-reduce and a separate norm on its FFN output. This PR ports the NVIDIA wiring:

- `MiniMaxM3MoE` and `MiniMaxM3MLP` are built with `reduce_results=False`. `MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred` reports whether a layer left its FFN output un-reduced.
- `MiniMaxM3Model._configure_allreduce_fusion` sets `fuse_input_allreduce` on each layer that follows a deferring layer. The final norm picks up the last layer's reduce.
- MTP blocks (`is_mtp_block=True`) and PP > 1 keep reducing as before. MTP adds the residual directly, and PP sends hidden states across stages.
- An EAGLE3 aux capture taken right after a deferring layer reduces a copy, so it never records a per-rank partial sum.

**Why land this before it shows a speedup.** An upcoming PR will move MiniMax-M3 on ROCm to a faster fused all-reduce + norm kernel (the AITER side is ROCm/aiter#6404 has already been merged). That kernel only helps the FFN all-reduce if the model defers it into the next norm, which is what this PR does. In our MI350X runs (TP4) this combination gave about +5 % at 60k/600 c64 and about +2 % at 8k/1k c32, against about +3 % at 60k c64 without this PR. NVIDIA already does this, so it also brings the two models in line. Full numbers will come with that PR.

**Not a duplicate.** I searched open PRs for "MiniMax-M3 all-reduce", "fuse_input_allreduce" and "ffn_all_reduce_deferred". Nothing open ports this wiring to the AMD model.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks for the PR! Can you add the serve and bench commands to the description? A concurrency 1 point would also help, since that's where a per-layer all-reduce change shows most. And the Validation section still describes the CPU-only test with stand-in layers. Can you post the run of the current test file on this head?

This adds an extra all-reduce for every EAGLE3 capture after a deferring layer: the capture reduces a copy, and the next layer's input norm then reduces the same tensor again. The NVIDIA model splits the layer into `forward_input_norm` and `forward_after_input_norm` and clones `residual` after the norm instead. Can you do the same here? Then `_aux_needs_reduce` isn't needed either

+    def _configure_allreduce_fusion(self) -> None:
+        """Fuse each deferred FFN all-reduce into the next layer's input norm,
+        or into the final norm after the last layer."""
+        layers = self.layers[self.start_layer : self.end_layer]
+        prev_defers = False
+        for idx, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.fuse_input_allreduce = idx > 0 and prev_defers
+            prev_defers = layer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred
+        self.fuse_final_norm_allreduce = prev_defers
+        deferred = sum(layer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred for layer in layers)
+        if deferred:
+            logger.info_once(
+                "MiniMax-M3: deferring %d/%d FFN all-reduces into the next norm "
+                "(%d before an MXFP8 input norm)",
+                deferred,
+                len(layers),
+                sum(
+                    layer.fuse_input_allreduce and layer.fuse_input_norm_mxfp8
+                    for layer in layers
+                ),
+            )
+

+        """Whether the hidden states captured at ``layer_idx`` are still a
+        per-rank partial sum."""
+        return (

+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _run_deferred_matches_reduced(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port
+):
+    from vllm.config import ModelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context

+                    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(

+                    )
+                    std = 0.1 if p.ndim == 1 else p.shape[-1] ** -0.5
+                    p.copy_(torch.randn(p.shape, generator=g, device=device) * std)
+            process_weights_after_loading(model, model_config, device)
+            model._set_aux_hidden_state_layers(tuple(range(1, LAYERS + 1)))
+            return model, vllm_config
+
+        input_ids = torch.arange(37, device=device) * 7 % 256
+        positions = torch.arange(37, device=device)
+        outputs = []
+        for defer in (True, False):
+            model, vllm_config = build(defer)
+            with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+                outputs.append(model(input_ids, positions, None))
+        (got, got_aux), (ref, ref_aux) = outputs
+        for a, b in zip([got, *got_aux], [ref, *ref_aux], strict=True):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+

+def test_deferred_matches_reduced_at_tp2(checkpoint, monkeypatch, use_aiter):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MiniMax-M3 (AMD) defers each FFN all-reduce into the next norm.
+
+Every deferred all-reduce must be finished exactly once, by the next layer's
+input norm or the final norm; an EAGLE3 capture must never record a per-rank
+partial sum; and mono decode, whose kernels expect reduced layer outputs, must
+turn deferral off. A tiny model on one rank checks the wiring, and at TP2 its
+final hidden states and captures must match the model that reduces every FFN.
+"""
+
+import os
+import zlib
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_default_torch_dtype
+
+from ...utils import (
+    ensure_model_parallel_initialized,
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="MiniMax-M3 AMD model"
+)
+
+LAYERS = 5
+DENSE = 2
+_CKPT_ENV = "VLLM_TEST_M3_XLAYER_CKPT"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def checkpoint(tmp_path_factory):
+    from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.minimax_m3 import MiniMaxM3Config
+
+    path = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("minimax_m3_tiny")
+    no_sparse = [0] * LAYERS
+    MiniMaxM3Config(
+        text_config=dict(
+            vocab_size=256,
+            hidden_size=256,
+            intermediate_size=128,
+            dense_intermediate_size=256,
+            num_hidden_layers=LAYERS,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_key_value_heads=2,
+            head_dim=128,
+            rotary_dim=64,
+            num_local_experts=4,
+            num_experts_per_tok=2,
+            moe_layer_freq=[0] * DENSE + [1] * (LAYERS - DENSE),
+            sparse_attention_config=dict(
+                use_sparse_attention=True,
+                sparse_index_dim=64,
+                sparse_num_index_heads=1,
+                sparse_topk_blocks=4,
+                sparse_block_size=128,
+                sparse_disable_index_value=no_sparse,
+                sparse_score_type="max",
+                sparse_init_block=0,
+                sparse_local_block=1,
+                sparse_attention_freq=no_sparse,
+            ),
+        ),
+        architectures=["MiniMaxM3SparseForCausalLM"],
+        torch_dtype="bfloat16",
+    ).save_pretrained(path)
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _build(checkpoint):
+    from vllm.config import ModelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.model import MiniMaxM3Model
+
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(model_config=ModelConfig(checkpoint, max_model_len=1024))
+    with (
+        set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config),
+        set_default_torch_dtype(torch.bfloat16),
+        torch.device("cuda"),
+    ):
+        return MiniMaxM3Model(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix="model")
+
+
+def test_each_deferred_all_reduce_completes_once(dist_init, checkpoint):
+    model = _build(checkpoint)
+    deferred = [layer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred for layer in model.layers]
+    assert all(deferred)
+    assert [layer.fuse_input_allreduce for layer in model.layers] == [
+        False,
+        *deferred[:-1],
+    ]
+    assert model.fuse_final_norm_allreduce
+
+
+def test_eagle3_captures_after_a_deferring_layer_are_reduced(dist_init, checkpoint):
+    model = _build(checkpoint)
+    assert not model._aux_needs_reduce(0)
+    assert all(model._aux_needs_reduce(idx) for idx in range(1, LAYERS + 1))
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _run_deferred_matches_reduced(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port
+):
+    from vllm.config import ModelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.model import MiniMaxM3Model
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.mono.envs import envs
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    with monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+        m.delenv("HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+        device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+        torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+        init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+        ensure_model_parallel_initialized(tp_size, pp_size)
+        init_workspace_manager(device)
+
+        def build(defer: bool):
+            # Mono decode is the switch that turns deferral off; at TP2 it then
+            # refuses the deployment, so both models run the same layer loop.
+            m.setattr(envs, "MONO_ENABLE", not defer)
+            model_config = ModelConfig(os.environ[_CKPT_ENV], max_model_len=1024)
+            vllm_config = VllmConfig(model_config=model_config)
+            with (
+                set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config),
+                set_default_torch_dtype(torch.bfloat16),
+                device,
+            ):
+                model = MiniMaxM3Model(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix="model")
+            assert model.fuse_final_norm_allreduce is defer
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                for name, p in model.named_parameters():
+                    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(
+                        zlib.crc32(f"{name}/{rank}".encode())
+                    )
+                    std = 0.1 if p.ndim == 1 else p.shape[-1] ** -0.5
+                    p.copy_(torch.randn(p.shape, generator=g, device=device) * std)
+            process_weights_after_loading(model, model_config, device)
+            model._set_aux_hidden_state_layers(tuple(range(1, LAYERS + 1)))
+            return model, vllm_config
+
+        input_ids = torch.arange(37, device=device) * 7 % 256
+        positions = torch.arange(37, device=device)
+        outputs = []
+        for defer in (True, False):
+            model, vllm_config = build(defer)
+            with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+                outputs.append(model(input_ids, positions, None))
+        (got, got_aux), (ref, ref_aux) = outputs
+        for a, b in zip([got, *got_aux], [ref, *ref_aux], strict=True):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_aiter", [False, True])
+def test_deferred_matches_reduced_at_tp2(checkpoint, monkeypatch, use_aiter):
